description: A React component that renders a real-time dashboard for monitoring OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) metrics. It includes data fetching, WebSocket connections for live updates, and rendering of KPIs and trend charts.

methods.name: fmtPct
methods.description: Formats a number as a percentage string.

methods.name: statusColor
methods.description: Returns a color string based on a line's status state.

methods.name: shortTime
methods.description: Converts an ISO timestamp string to a short, human-readable time string.

methods.name: seedSeries
methods.description: Generates a mock time series of OEE points for initial chart data.
